name: WARNING: Red Lobster Cheddar Bay Biscuits (Garlic Butter & Cheese)
whyItWorks: Drop biscuits packed with sharp cheddar cheese, leavening agents, and drenched fresh out of the oven in melted garlic-herb butter. The saturated dairy fat and heavy garlic powder create rapid abdominal distension and cramping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Tell your server to withhold the biscuit basket from the table to eliminate temptation during active disease or recovery.
